the self training algorithm can be successfully applied to eukaryotic genes, and that the self training method can be applied to novel eukaryotes.
1) the self training algorithm can be used for eukaryotic genes identification and 2) it is possible to identify novel genes in the novel genomes.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel methods for the analysis of genomic DNA sequences.
the development of a novel gene finding algorithm and its application to the analysis of novel genomes.
the development of a novel method of parallelization between the gene finding and the model training steps in the process of eukaryote gene identification in novel genomes.

the method of self training algorithm is an alternative and a viable option to the conventional supervised training for gene finding in new eukaryotic species.
